## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added, including at least one `:negative` test where behavior could be abused or misused
- [ ] Coverage still 100/100 (`bin/rails coverage:check`) — no gate games
- [ ] ADR added/updated in `docs/decisions/` if this makes an architectural choice
- [ ] Privacy policy / ToS impact considered (does this touch user data?)
- [ ] Gotcha capture: repeated problem → mechanism (`docs/gotchas.md`)
- [ ] Plan progress updated (`plans/…`) if this implements plan work
